description: Full hook suite: memory lifecycle, quality gates, security guardrail, standing rules, slides validation

hooks.prompt: Check if the file just written is a .pptx or .html presentation file. If it is a .pptx file, verify: (1) the generation script included h.validateDeck() before saving, (2) speaker notes are mentioned in the script. If it is an .html file, verify: (1) it includes viewport-fitting CSS (100vh/100dvh), (2) it includes prefers-reduced-motion support, (3) font sizes use clamp() not fixed values. If the file is not a presentation, return 'approve' immediately.

RETROSPECTIVE: Before closing out, do a quick self-reflection on what just happened this session.

1. What was accomplished? Summarize in 1-2 sentences.
2. Did this session produce a DURABLE fact? If YES, delegate to memory-updater. If NO, skip silently.
Respect git-safety: this retrospective never commits, pushes, or branches.

If the current task involved creating slides or a presentation, verify before stopping: (1) output files were generated (.pptx and/or .html), (2) speaker notes are present on content slides, (3) the user was shown the output file path. If the task was not slide-related, approve immediately.

Either the stopping subagent is not the reviewer, or its report is well-formed. For the reviewer: MUST contain VERDICT: GREEN or VERDICT: RED. If GREEN, verbatim gate output required. If RED, at least one concrete failure (input to wrong output). Opinions never block GREEN. A clean diff returning GREEN on round 1 is correct.
